title: OAuth M2M authentication for the Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Jira connectors
body: OAuth machine-to-machine (M2M) authentication is now generally available for the [Salesforce](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/salesforce-connection#oauth-m2m-authentication), [ServiceNow](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/servicenow-connection), and [Jira](/aws/en/ingestion/lakeflow-connect/jira-connection) connectors in Lakeflow Connect. M2M uses the OAuth client credentials flow, so no one signs in interactively. For Jira, M2M supports Jira Cloud only.
